components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single emphasized action in a toolbar or form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #4F46E5; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6366F1; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F46E5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #3730A3; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting or reset action beside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F9FAFB; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F46E5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #F3F4F6; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #B91C1C; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #991B1B; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B91C1C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #7F1D1D; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The canonical compact search and filter field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: #374151; font: 600 0.75rem/1.25 Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; top: 50%; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; color: #9CA3AF; stroke-width: 2; transform: translateY(-50%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { width: 16rem; border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem 0.375rem 2.5rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9CA3AF; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #2563EB; outline: 2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A labeled semantic state with color used as reinforcement.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid rgb(21 128 61 / 0.20); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #F0FDF4; color: #15803D; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font: 600 0.75rem/1.25 Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #15803D; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: A dense operational table with quiet headers and bounded values.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-table { width: 100%; min-width: 48rem; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; color: #6B7280; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-table th { background: #F9FAFB; color: #111827; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; } .ds-table td { border-top: 1px solid #E5E7EB; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #F9FAFB; } .ds-table-truncate { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-table-state { color: #15803D; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Side Navigation Item
components.description: A compact navigation row with a quiet active surface and signal icon.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: transparent; color: #374151; padding: 0.5rem; text-align: left; font: 600 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F3F4F6; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F46E5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #F3F4F6; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; flex: none; color: #4F46E5; stroke-width: 1.75; }

components.css: .ds-modal { width: min(32rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #FFFFFF; color: #6B7280; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-modal-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; } .ds-modal h2 { margin: 0; color: #111827; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-modal-close { border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #FFFFFF; color: #9CA3AF; padding: 0.25rem; } .ds-modal-close svg { display: block; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-modal-close:hover { color: #6B7280; } .ds-modal-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F46E5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-modal footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-modal-action { border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #4F46E5; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-modal-action:hover { background: #6366F1; } .ds-modal-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F46E5; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
FS PBX is a calm, compact working surface for PBX administrators and communications operators. Picture an administrator scanning routes, registrations, messages, and logs on a desktop monitor in a bright office or equipment room: the light theme keeps dense operational data legible, while restrained Signal Indigo marks the few controls and states that require attention.

The interface is practical, dependable, and direct. Familiar tables, filters, side navigation, forms, and dialogs should disappear into the task. FS PBX explicitly rejects marketing-style admin UI, decorative dashboards, novelty interactions, inconsistent component patterns, and visual treatments that compete with operational data.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet gray surfaces with Signal Indigo used sparingly.
Familiar administrative controls with explicit states and permissions.
Technical detail preserved through truncation, expansion, tooltips, and progressive disclosure.
Responsive structure based on breakpoints, not fluid type or decorative rearrangement.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Signal Indigo must remain under roughly 10% of a normal screen. Use it for primary action, selection, and focus, never to decorate inactive surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Status must combine color with a text label, icon, or both. Color alone is never sufficient.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Product typography uses fixed rem sizes. Never introduce fluid display type, oversized marketing headings, or a second decorative font.

rules.name: The Technical Detail Rule
rules.body: Long prose should stay within 65–75 characters per line. Tables may remain dense, but identifiers and URLs must truncate in-row and remain fully available in an expanded view or tooltip.

rules.name: The Structural Elevation Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal changes for persistent structure. Reserve strong shadows for elements that physically float above the working surface.

rules.name: The Single Container Rule
rules.body: One page-level working surface is sufficient. Nested cards and repeated shadow boxes are prohibited.

dos: Do use Signal Indigo (`#4F46E5`) for the primary action, active state, and focus indication.
Do use Paper Surface, Quiet Surface, Console Canvas, Divider, and Control Border to establish hierarchy before adding shadows.
Do keep tables compact and scannable, with responsive horizontal overflow and bounded columns.
Do preserve technical detail through expandable rows, tooltips, copy controls, and monospace output.
Do pass page-specific permissions into the page and hide or disable unavailable actions explicitly.
Do provide default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, and empty states for interactive components.
Do use text labels and icons alongside semantic color.
Do reuse VueForm, Headless UI, Heroicons, DataTable, Paginator, Badge, Notification, and established FS PBX page patterns.
donts: Don't create marketing-style admin UI, decorative dashboards, or oversized hero metrics.
Don't add novelty interactions, gratuitous animation, or motion unrelated to state.
Don't introduce inconsistent component patterns; the same action must look and behave the same across pages.
Don't use visual treatments that compete with operational data.
Don't disguise technical state or destructive actions.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, colored side-stripe borders, or repeated identical card grids.
Don't wrap every content group in a card or nest cards inside cards.
Don't let unbounded URLs, payloads, identifiers, or descriptions expand a table beyond the viewport.
Don't rely on color alone for status, error, warning, selection, or health.
Don't introduce a second display font, fluid product typography, or decorative uppercase tracking in ordinary controls.
